checkedBy: Opus (claude-opus-5-5), fresh independent verifier session; not the builder
scope: Staging preview browser behavior for PR3 and PR4 only. No full I2, production, cross-tenant authorization or I1 audit claim.

method.perCall: --target, --account-label and the run's four --allowed-origin values on every nav/eval/click/box/activate call
method.verification: sanitized DOM predicates read by eval after each action (booleans for fixture text/ids, control labels with any '@' string dropped, same-origin link paths), target URL origin+path; CDP acknowledgements not counted
method.notRead: no cookie, token, localStorage/sessionStorage values, network auth data, page bodies or account PII were read or saved
method.unrelatedTabs: three pre-existing tabs (WorkOS dashboard, Google Cloud console, Instagram) not attached or touched
method.resourcesKept: PR3 tab 1 and PR4 tab 2 left open; PR3 ends signed in on its record, PR4 ends signed in on its record; no provider, preview, setting or data change

notRun: any app consent, scope, setting, message or data write
